284598148.description: Boxed fossil and mineral collection from Roynon Museum of Paleontology titled 'Fossils From Around The World.' Contains nine labeled specimens: pyrite, brachiopod, sulphur, amethyst, rock crystal, galena, chalcopyrite, rose quartz, and green citrine. Each specimen is mounted in a display grid. Exterior features colorful dinosaur artwork and museum information. Side marked with collection date 10/9/09 and name Amelia. Box measures approximately 8.5 by 6 inches. Used condition with minor wear. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or museum memorabilia.

284548193.description: This lot includes four vintage used vacuum tubes from National brand: 2C39 and 7289 models. Made in the USA, these tubes feature metal and ceramic construction. They were typically used as radio frequency power amplifiers in industrial, military, and amateur radio equipment. Tubes show signs of wear and oxidation, with handwritten notes on bases indicating previous use and condition, such as 'R. Final 2C39 5-20-85 USED' and '+V.G.++'. All tubes appear structurally intact but are sold as used and may require testing or refurbishment before operational use. Suitable for collectors, restorers, or those needing period-correct replacements for vintage RF or transmitter gear. not tested
